mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses equity discount rates by reducing risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% for three months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad-based demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue visibility, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors price in earnings revisions.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases (i.e., returns positive when both series decline).

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles characterized by rising federal funds rates, increased cost of capital compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods classified as monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.1% in 3 months).

mechanism_narrative: Strong nonfarm payrolls growth above 140 million indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 140 million.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1,000,000 units per month signals housing sector weakness that reduces construction activity and consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST is below 1000.0.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 107.0 indicates manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate output and profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 107.0.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation that may prompt central bank rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher discount rates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%.
